rows.section: PMBRC introduction in Quality and Research
rows.original: No explanation of PMBRC beneath its logo.
rows.changes: PMBRC is the Pharmaceutical and Molecular Biotechnology Research Centre at South East Technological University in Waterford. Part of the Enterprise Ireland Technology Gateway Network, it gives pharmaceutical and healthcare companies access to specialist researchers, analytical facilities and applied R&D.

rows.section: PMBRC introduction in Quality and Research
rows.original: No explanation of its role in Irish pharmaceutical industry.
rows.changes: Its work supports Ireland’s pharmaceutical industry through contract analysis, feasibility studies and collaborative research, including pharmaceutical analysis, formulation and drug delivery. PMBRC received the Research and Development Achievement Award at the 2017 Pharma Industry Awards.
